description: Foundation-model company spun out of MIT CSAIL, based in Cambridge, Massachusetts (US). Builds LFM (Liquid Foundation Models) for on-device and hosted use, including end-to-end audio models (LFM3-Audio, LFM3-Omni) that do ASR, TTS, speech translation and spoken chat in one model; sold per token via the OpenAI-compatible Liquid API and released as open weights under the revenue-capped LFM Open License.
name: Liquid AI
